forms.BUG_INTRO: 🐞 Bug report Answer the questions one by one. Cancel any time with /cancel.
forms.BUG_ASK_DESCRIPTION: 1/6. Description A short summary of the problem.
forms.BUG_ASK_STEPS: 2/6. Steps to reproduce The exact actions or request body that triggers the bug: 1. … 2. … 3. …
forms.BUG_ASK_EXPECTED: 4/6. Expected result How should it have worked?
forms.BUG_ASK_ENVIRONMENT: 5/6. Environment Browser, device OS or client (Postman, terminal, Chrome, etc.). If it is a regular browser, just tap the button.
forms.BUG_ASK_ATTACHMENTS: 6/6. Attachments Screenshots, screen recordings, error logs, server responses. You can send several files in a row; log text can be sent as a message too. When you are done, tap "Done".
forms.BUG_ASK_ATTACHMENTS_OPTIONAL: 6/6. Attachments (optional) Screenshots, screen recordings, error logs, server responses. You can send several files in a row; log text can be sent as a message too. When you are done, tap "Done", or "Skip" if there are no attachments.
forms.BUG_ATTACHMENTS_REQUIRED: At least one attachment is required: a screenshot, screen recording or log.
forms.FEATURE_INTRO: 💡 Feature request Three short questions. Cancel with /cancel. Feature requests are published openly — everyone sees the full text.
forms.FEATURE_ASK_IDEA: 1/3. The idea A short description of the new feature or integration.
forms.FEATURE_ASK_PROBLEM: 2/3. Problem it solves Why end users or third-party developers need it.
forms.FEATURE_ASK_IMPLEMENTATION: 3/3. Expected implementation How exactly it should work: logic, parameters, references.
forms.CHANGELOG_ASK_TEXT: Changelog text. Telegram formatting is preserved.
forms.LLM_PROCESSING: ⏳ Processing the bug report through the AI model to prepare a short summary for the post. This can take up to {seconds} seconds, please wait…
forms.NEED_TEXT: Text is required, sent as a message.
forms.TOO_LONG: Too long: {n} characters, maximum {max}. Please shorten it.
forms.LONG_LOG_HINT: A long log is better sent as a file.
forms.ACCEPTED_ATTACHMENT: 📎 Attachments received: {n}. Send more or tap "Done".
forms.TOPIC_NOT_CONFIGURED: The topic for this is not configured yet, message the admins.
forms.NOT_A_MEMBER: Reports are accepted only from beta chat members.

access.NO_ACCESS:
This bot only works for TradeCloud beta testers.

You can request beta access at @{bot}.

start.START_TEXT:
Hi! I'm TradeCloud Curator, the beta chat bot.

/bug_report — report a bug
/feature — suggest an idea
/cancel — cancel the form
start.ADMIN_HELP: For admins: /admin — admin menu (buttons, people, drafts, notifications) /changelog — publish a changelog /status ID status [comment] — change a report's status /report ID — open a report /topic_id — (in chat) show the topic id /scan_topics [max_id] — find every topic and post its id into each /test_topics — test post to every topic from .env

group.GROUP_GO_TO_PM: {user}, let's continue in the bot's private chat 👉
group.GROUP_OPEN_PM: {user}, open the bot first and tap Start — the form will begin on its own.

details.DETAILS_DENIED: This is not available to you

edit.EDIT_PROMPT: This is yours — you can edit the text and attachments.
edit.EDIT_ASK_FIELD: {title} Send the new text. Cancel with /cancel.
edit.EDIT_DENIED: You can only edit your own report.
edit.EDIT_ATT_HEADER: 📎 Attachments ({n}) Remove what you don't need or add new ones.
edit.EDIT_ATT_ASK: Send files (photos, videos, documents, logs). When done — tap "Done" or /done.

moderation.MOD_WARNING: {user}, message removed: sharing contacts or luring people elsewhere is not allowed in the chat.
moderation.MOD_MUTED: {user} is muted for {minutes} min for repeated violations.

admin.ADMIN_BUTTONS_LIST: Form buttons Pick a step to configure its quick-reply buttons.
admin.ADMIN_BUTTONS_ADD_PROMPT: Step "{step}". Send the button label (its caption). /cancel to abort.
admin.ADMIN_BUTTONS_ASK_VALUE: Now send the value — the text that fills the answer when tapped.
admin.ADMIN_NOTIFY_LIST: Admin notifications Detailed, in private chat / log chat. Tap to toggle.
admin.ADMIN_LOGS_LIST: Logs topic Short entries (no details — no who/what/where) in the logs topic. Tap to toggle an event.
admin.ADMIN_PEOPLE_LIST: Connected people ({total}) 🤖 — opened the bot's private chat. Pick a person for actions.
admin.ADMIN_DRAFTS_LIST: Drafts ({total}) Unfinished forms. Pick one to view.
admin.ADMIN_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND: Draft not found or already finished.
